setup.snapshot.summary: Save restorable channel/timebase/EDGE settings plus a native setup archive; return a persistent ID.
setup.snapshot.effects: No scope settings changed. Saves instrument Setups, not waveform samples. Retains 32 snapshots for 30 days.
setup.snapshot.requirements: Do not operate the front panel while saving. Use setup.restore with the returned artifact_id.

verification.scope: Native setup archive and explicit settings captured on the physical scope; persisted across sessions. Native import failed live verification and is disabled.

setup.snapshot.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

setup.info.summary: Inspect a saved setup's identity and independently verified settings.
setup.info.effects: No instrument access; validates saved payload integrity.

verification.scope: Saved snapshot metadata and integrity retrieved across server instances; identity and corruption rejection unit-tested. Retained for 30 days or 32 snapshots.

setup.info.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

setup.restore.summary: Restore saved channel/timebase/EDGE settings with readback checks and a pre-restore backup.
setup.restore.effects: Restores listed settings using validated commands; does not import the native blob or restore other settings. May invalidate retained data. Temporarily runs with AUTO depth during restoration, then defaults to STOP; saved explicitly resumes a previously running setup. Saves a rollback ID; does not automatically roll back failures.
setup.restore.requirements: Same instrument serial/model/firmware; current and saved MAIN/NORMAL/analog EDGE setups. Controls enabled, no armed acquisition or recording/replay. Covers both channels, main scale/offset, memory depth and EDGE settings. Native import failed verification on this firmware and is disabled.

verification.scope: Validated-command restoration of channel coupling, timebase, depth and running/stopped state passed live readback checks. Limited to the documented MAIN/NORMAL/analog EDGE settings; no all-settings or waveform restoration claim.

setup.restore.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

acquisition.capture_single.summary: Arm, wait for one event, and save its full-memory waveform in one bounded workflow.

timeout_seconds.description: Trigger wait budget; USB calls may extend it.

transfer_timeout_seconds.description: Additional memory transfer budget. Client timeout must exceed both budgets plus cleanup.

acquisition.capture_single.effects: Saves the prior setup, replaces retained acquisition, selects SINGLE and leaves STOP on completion/timeout. No forced trigger, automatic retry or automatic resume. On success returns a saved waveform; timeout publishes none.
acquisition.capture_single.requirements: Controls enabled, MAIN/NORMAL, enabled channel, no armed acquisition or recording/replay. Configure trigger first. Do not use the front panel during the call: external STOP cannot be distinguished from completion. Default client timeout should be at least 180 seconds.

verification.scope: Live CH1 compensation signal completed a single full-memory capture; unreachable trigger timed out with STOP and no waveform artifact. Prior setup restored. External front-panel STOP cannot be distinguished from a completed trigger.

acquisition.capture_single.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

acquisition.memory.get.summary: Read memory-depth selection, sample rate and available depths for enabled channels.

verification.scope: AUTO and explicit 24M selection plus sample-rate queries verified on CH1-only setup.

acquisition.memory.get.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

acquisition.memory.set.summary: Explicitly select acquisition memory depth, including MAXIMUM or AUTO.

depth.description: String point count, AUTO, or MAXIMUM. MAXIMUM resolves to 24M for one enabled channel or 12M for two.

acquisition.memory.set.effects: May invalidate retained data and change sampling rate. Does not start acquisition or wait for fresh data. Refuses STOP/WAIT or armed single acquisition; this firmware times out on memory-depth writes while stopped.
acquisition.memory.set.requirements: Controls enabled, acquisition running, at least one channel enabled. Permitted numeric depths depend on enabled channel count; use acquisition.memory.get if needed. Explicitly run the scope first only if replacing retained data is intended.

verification.scope: MAXIMUM (24M, CH1-only) and restoration to AUTO verified while running. Stopped-state writes timed out on this firmware and are now rejected before writing. Other explicit depths and dual-channel settings are unit-tested only.

acquisition.memory.set.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

waveform.full_memory.summary: Capture all currently acquired memory for one channel into a saved, calibrated waveform artifact.

acquisition_policy.description: Default requires STOP. Explicit stop_and_resume pauses normal running acquisition and resumes it afterward; never interrupts waiting/single triggers.

timeout_seconds.description: Transfer time budget; an in-flight USB call and cleanup may extend it. Allow client timeout above this budget.

waveform.full_memory.effects: Uses BYTE/RAW transfer windows and attempts to restore previous transfer settings. Explicit stop_and_resume can replace the retained acquisition on resume. Complete captures are saved even if cleanup fails; partial captures are discarded. No automatic retry.
waveform.full_memory.requirements: Controls enabled, channel enabled, MAIN timebase, NORMAL acquisition. Reads current memory depth (up to 24M points); does not increase depth or await a new trigger. Do not operate the scope during transfer. Artifacts persist for up to seven days or eight captures, whichever is shorter.

verification.scope: CH1 NORMAL/MAIN captures at 2.4M, 6M and 24M points. Repeated 24M captures matched exactly; sample calibration agreed with the 1 kHz compensation signal. Stop/resume and stopped-state preservation verified. CH2 and other acquisition modes are not hardware-tested.

waveform.full_memory.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

waveform.info.summary: Retrieve a saved full-memory capture's compact summary and calibration, without instrument access.

verification.scope: Saved 24M capture metadata and integrity read after a fresh network MCP connection.

waveform.info.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

waveform.samples.summary: Read an exact bounded region of saved full-memory waveform samples in seconds and channel amplitude units.

start.description: Zero-based sample index in the complete capture.

waveform.samples.effects: No scope access. Returns at most 2000 contiguous calibrated samples; no decimation. A final short page is allowed; next_start is null at the end.

verification.scope: Exact calibrated sample ranges verified across two 250k transfer boundaries and at the final short page of a 24M capture.

waveform.samples.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

channel.get.summary: Read all channel settings, including coupling, probe, scale, offset and deskew.

verification.scope: All returned settings read on both channels.

channel.get.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

channel.set.summary: Configure a channel with validation and actual readback.

probe_ratio.description: Match the physical probe; changes displayed scale, not the probe.

scale_per_division.description: In the channel amplitude unit; range 0.001..10 times probe ratio.

range.description: Eight divisions, in the channel amplitude unit. Alternative to scale_per_division.

offset.description: In the channel amplitude unit; bounds depend on scale and probe ratio.

deskew_seconds.description: Delay correction, quantized by timebase; adjustable only below 10 us/div.

channel.set.effects: Changes only requested fields, but probe/scale/range/fine-scale can affect each other and trigger limits. May invalidate a retained capture. No automatic rollback after partial failure.
channel.set.requirements: Controls enabled. Use either range or scale_per_division. Numeric amplitude values use the selected channel unit. Probe setting must match the physical probe.

verification.scope: All parameter fields exercised and restored across CH1/CH2. Deskew tested at 1 us/div. This does not verify every allowed value or analog accuracy.

channel.set.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

trigger.edge.get.summary: Read active trigger type, sweep and edge-trigger configuration.
trigger.edge.get.effects: None. Edge settings may be inactive when the trigger type is not EDGE.

verification.scope: Read with EDGE active.

trigger.edge.get.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

trigger.edge.set.summary: Select EDGE trigger and configure source, slope, level, sweep, coupling, holdoff or noise rejection.

level.description: Source amplitude units; ±5 divisions minus channel offset. Remote setting currently requires CHAN1/CHAN2.

coupling.description: Only applicable with an analog channel source.

holdoff_seconds.description: Time before trigger can rearm, in seconds.

sweep.description: Single selects sweep behavior; use acquisition(single) to explicitly arm.

trigger.edge.set.effects: Selects EDGE even if another trigger type was active. Can change acquisition behavior or replace a captured trace. Does not wait for a new trigger. No automatic rollback after partial failure.
trigger.edge.set.requirements: Controls enabled. Level and coupling settings require CHAN1/CHAN2 source; level bounds use that channel's actual scale and offset.

verification.scope: Tested CHAN1/CHAN2, POS/NEG/RFAL, DC/HFR coupling, level, holdoff, noise reject, AUTO/NORM. EXT/AC source, AC/LFR coupling, SING sweep and switching from non-EDGE are not hardware-tested.

trigger.edge.set.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

screenshot.capture.summary: Save a color PNG screenshot of the current display; return a small artifact receipt.
screenshot.capture.effects: Does not stop acquisition. Running display can change during capture; image is not raw waveform data.
screenshot.capture.requirements: Saved on the MCP host. Fetch with artifact.image; retained for up to seven days or the most recent 64 images, whichever is shorter.

verification.scope: 800x480 BMP24 transfer, lossless host PNG encoding and image integrity validated while running. Native firmware PNG has invalid metadata CRCs and is not used.

screenshot.capture.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

artifact.image.summary: Retrieve a saved screenshot as native MCP image content, including from a later connection.
artifact.image.effects: None. Returns image content only when explicitly requested.

verification.scope: Native MCP image retrieved over SSH, including after a fresh MCP connection.

artifact.image.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

decode.uart.configure.summary: Configure UART serial-bus hardware decoding with explicit wiring, readback and a saved previous decoder configuration.

decoder.description: Decoder slot 1 or 2, not channel number.

threshold_ch1.description: CH1 threshold in its amplitude unit, within ±4 divisions minus offset; supplied thresholds disable automatic threshold.

threshold_ch2.description: CH2 threshold in its amplitude unit, within ±4 divisions minus offset; supplied thresholds disable automatic threshold.

polarity.description: POS for normal TTL UART; NEG for inverted RS232 signaling.

decode.uart.configure.effects: Changes only the selected decoder and its event-table display. Does not change trigger, channels or acquisition. Sets HEX/package/ascending event view. Returns previous configuration for decode.restore.
decode.uart.configure.requirements: Connected channels must already be enabled and appropriately scaled. Configure while stopped or normally running, never while waiting/single armed. UART defaults 8N1/POS/LSB; I2C excludes R/W from address; SPI defaults 8-bit/POS/MSB and uses timeout framing (two-channel scope). Omitted threshold defaults to automatic. Actual decoding depends on valid signal and capture length.

verification.scope: CH1 10,000-baud 8N1 positive-polarity UART configuration read back correctly. Compensation square wave decoded as repeated F0 frames at 1 ms spacing.

decode.uart.configure.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

decode.i2c.configure.summary: Configure I2C serial-bus hardware decoding with explicit wiring, readback and a saved previous decoder configuration.

decoder.description: Decoder slot 1 or 2, not channel number.

threshold_ch1.description: CH1 threshold in its amplitude unit, within ±4 divisions minus offset; supplied thresholds disable automatic threshold.

threshold_ch2.description: CH2 threshold in its amplitude unit, within ±4 divisions minus offset; supplied thresholds disable automatic threshold.

address_format.description: NORM excludes R/W from displayed address; RW includes it.

decode.i2c.configure.effects: Changes only the selected decoder and its event-table display. Does not change trigger, channels or acquisition. Sets HEX/package/ascending event view. Returns previous configuration for decode.restore.
decode.i2c.configure.requirements: Connected channels must already be enabled and appropriately scaled. Configure while stopped or normally running, never while waiting/single armed. UART defaults 8N1/POS/LSB; I2C excludes R/W from address; SPI defaults 8-bit/POS/MSB and uses timeout framing (two-channel scope). Omitted threshold defaults to automatic. Actual decoding depends on valid signal and capture length.

verification.scope: Clock CH1/data CH2 configuration read back correctly. Actual I2C traffic decoding remains unverified pending a wired test source.

decode.i2c.configure.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

decode.spi.configure.summary: Configure SPI serial-bus hardware decoding with explicit wiring, readback and a saved previous decoder configuration.

decoder.description: Decoder slot 1 or 2, not channel number.

threshold_ch1.description: CH1 threshold in its amplitude unit, within ±4 divisions minus offset; supplied thresholds disable automatic threshold.

threshold_ch2.description: CH2 threshold in its amplitude unit, within ±4 divisions minus offset; supplied thresholds disable automatic threshold.

data.description: One observed data direction; mapped to scope MOSI field. Two channels cannot observe clock, CS and both data lines.

frame_timeout_seconds.description: Gap used to separate frames; greater than the longest clock pulse and shorter than the inter-frame idle gap.

decode.spi.configure.effects: Changes only the selected decoder and its event-table display. Does not change trigger, channels or acquisition. Sets HEX/package/ascending event view. Returns previous configuration for decode.restore.
decode.spi.configure.requirements: Connected channels must already be enabled and appropriately scaled. Configure while stopped or normally running, never while waiting/single armed. UART defaults 8N1/POS/LSB; I2C excludes R/W from address; SPI defaults 8-bit/POS/MSB and uses timeout framing (two-channel scope). Omitted threshold defaults to automatic. Actual decoding depends on valid signal and capture length.

verification.scope: Clock CH1/data CH2, RISE, 8-bit/MSB/POS, 10 us timeout configuration read back correctly. Actual SPI traffic decoding remains unverified pending a wired test source.

decode.spi.configure.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

decode.capture.summary: Capture and decode UART, I2C or SPI from full-resolution samples; choose settings and restore the previous setup automatically.

bit_rate.description: Known UART baud or maximum clock rate in Hz. Required; not auto-detected.

clock_channel.description: I2C/SPI only; must differ from data_channel.

logic_voltage.description: Actual positive logic supply voltage; threshold is half this value. No negative/inverted buses.

window_seconds.description: Minimum capture window; rounded up to a scope timebase. 10% before and 90% after trigger. Shorten for high rates.

frame_gap_seconds.description: SPI only: idle gap separating frames; >2 bit periods and less than the actual inter-frame gap. Defaults to 16/bit_rate.

timeout_seconds.description: Single-trigger wait budget; transfers/restoration add time. Set MCP client timeout >=180 seconds.

expected_hex.description: Optional 1..256 known bytes, e.g. 'A5 5A 00 FF'. Checks for an ordered data subsequence; not a protocol compliance test.

decode.capture.effects: Enables both channels, sets DC/volts/20 MHz bandwidth, scales, timebase, memory and analog EDGE trigger; replaces retained acquisition. Holds one instrument session through capture and restoration. Saves core setup and waveform IDs; restores saved core/acquisition state even on failure when communication permits. Does not change hardware decoder settings. Returns <=20 events by default, with bounded paging.
decode.capture.requirements: Controls enabled; initial MAIN/NORMAL/analog EDGE, no armed acquisition or recorder. UART 8N1 normal polarity with >=10 idle bit periods observed before initial framing, SPI mode 0/8-bit/MSB/timeout without CS, I2C 7-bit. User supplies correct wiring/rate/voltage/probe ratio. No front-panel/other-app changes during the call. <=600000 samples per channel using legal dual-channel depths; unsupported rounded window/rate plans rejected before instrument access. >=16 observed samples per declared bit required. No automatic retries or force triggers. Inspect quality separately from ok; ok denotes workflow/restore success, not verified payload. Persistence errors retain restoration details and recovery IDs but do not promise saved result pages.

verification.scope: Three physical captures each of TinyPICO UART 9600/8N1, SPI nominal 10 kHz/mode0/8-bit/MSB/timeout and synthetic I2C address 0x50 writes. Full known data sequences recovered, with checked core setup/acquisition restoration. Other rates, voltages, probe ratios and I2C read/repeated-start transactions are not hardware-verified. Full-resolution host decoding; not verification of wide-view hardware event tables.

decode.capture.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

decode.result.summary: Read a bounded page of saved capture-and-decode events and quality flags without accessing the scope.
decode.result.effects: Read-only. Integrity checked; up to 32 results retained for 30 days. Linked waveform artifacts have their own shorter retention.
decode.result.requirements: Use artifact_id from decode.capture. Interpret quality flags and expected_sequence_seen; decoded does not certify unknown bytes or electrical compliance.

verification.scope: Three physical captures each of TinyPICO UART 9600/8N1, SPI nominal 10 kHz/mode0/8-bit/MSB/timeout and synthetic I2C address 0x50 writes. Full known data sequences recovered, with checked core setup/acquisition restoration. Other rates, voltages, probe ratios and I2C read/repeated-start transactions are not hardware-verified. Full-resolution host decoding; not verification of wide-view hardware event tables.

decode.result.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

verification.scope: All implemented decoder configuration queries exercised on the physical scope.

decode.restore.summary: Restore a saved decoder configuration and event-table settings after an experiment.
decode.restore.effects: Changes decoder settings only; no acquisition changes. Same instrument and firmware required. Backups persist for 30 days or 32 backups. One-step UART baud/SPI timeout rounding is reported explicitly.

verification.scope: Decoder and event-table settings restored after UART/I2C/SPI changes. Observed 1 ns SPI timeout and 1 baud UART quantization are reported explicitly.

decode.restore.next_action: Call advanced_control with this operation and arguments.

decode.events.summary: Read a bounded page of the stopped scope's current hardware decode event table.
decode.events.effects: None. Reads instrument event table, not host decoding of full-memory artifacts. Normalizes recognized time/data cells and preserves other fields. Pages have a 16 KB event budget.
decode.events.requirements: Scope STOP, selected decoder enabled, event table enabled. Use protocol configure first. Configured protocol/baud/thresholds must match the physical signal.

verification.scope: Physical UART event table returned 23 F0 frames with 1 ms spacing; parsed time units and hexadecimal values. I2C/SPI payload formats remain unverified; unknown firmware fields are preserved.

decode.events.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.

analysis.fft.summary: Find dominant frequencies in a saved waveform, returning a compact calibrated FFT summary.
analysis.fft.effects: Host calculation only, no scope access. Uses an exact contiguous region without decimation, capped at 1,048,576 points. Returns bin-centered peaks, not a large spectrum array.
analysis.fft.requirements: Saved waveform.full_memory or acquisition.capture_single artifact. For finer frequency resolution capture at a lower sample rate or request a larger count. No automatic signal identification or pass/fail.

verification.scope: Physical 12,000-sample capture at 500 kSa/s returned 1/3/5/7/9 kHz peaks, as expected for the compensation square wave. Numerical tone/DC/Nyquist/region tests pass; not calibrated RF spectral accuracy.

analysis.fft.next_action: Call advanced_read with this operation and arguments.
